biotools.summary: SNPWay is an end-to-end web server and R package designed for streamlined SNP-to-function and pathway over-representation analysis. It translates variant lists (like SNPs) into functional hypotheses by combining various annotation and enrichment steps.
biotools.name: SNPWay
